supervisor_summary: Cheniere ($286.92) still trades above every forecaster's fair value. My reconciled set gives $227.03 (post-gate; was $242.27): EV/EBITDA 10.75x, ~8% below the 11.64x filing-based peer median the citation gate rebuilt from SEC filings (12.78x before, on aggregator ratios for ET/EPD/MPLX), P/DCF 10.0x on $24.6 after-SBC DCF/share, and DCF at 7.75%/1.75%. Checked at source: the CQP stake is $15.77B (244.16M units), KNTK's 13.2x is a share-count artefact, and cash taxes stay low to 2028. The agents' 60-70% fair-value ladder centring is anchoring, so I centre nearer the market (median ~$260, P(>= $287) 0.36). The thesis break is $165, below the $170 bear case. This is a low-beta, contracted name priced for a lasting windfall: hold off at today's price, and Q3 on Oct 29 and the Feb 2027 guide are the tests.
key_drivers: 2027 Adj. EBITDA after the 2026 windfall: guidance went $6.75-7.25B to $7.25-7.75B to $7.90-8.40B; reconciled 2027 $7.6B (agents $7.45-7.70B), each $0.25B ~$15/share on the EV/EBITDA leg; the Feb 2027 guide settles it.

Claims ahead of common equity: net debt $24.36B incl. $1.41B finance leases, the CQP public/sponsor stake at market $15.77B (244.16M units, not 248.8M), and ~$0.8B/yr of NCI distributions before the horizon.

Horizon multiples: 10.75x NTM GAAP EBITDA, ~8% below the 11.64x filing-based peer median (KNTK out; 12.78x on aggregator ratios for ET/EPD/MPLX before the citation gate; the median sits between MPLX 11.28x and OKE 12.00x), each 1.0x ~$38/share on that leg (~$15 on fair value); and 10.0x after-SBC DCF vs 11.0x today and 8.35x pre-crisis.
Buyback-driven DCF per share: ~$2.2B/yr retires ~3.5%/yr; management's ~$30/share run-rate DCF target assumes ~175M shares and expansion FIDs.
Cash taxes stay low (paid $32M FY2025, $30M H1 2026) while bonus depreciation lasts; the step-up toward book rates after 2028 sets the terminal.
